_comment: Template. Copy to <name>.json and edit. This file is never loaded as a site. name/wp_base/chat_id are required; everything else falls back to the defaults in shared/config.py. BulkFollows service ids are per site so a channel with different geo targeting can use a different service. emoji_pool picks by name from the NR_EMOJI_SERVICES catalogue in .env (the emoji glyph itself, or positive/negative for the mixed sets) and is opt-in by design: the full catalogue includes poop/middle-finger/vomit, which must never land on a client's news post by accident.
